notes.title: Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are 150% invested in the making of our next game but we continue to read and follow your feedback/bug reports in the Steam discussion and reviews. This update is the result of your feedback, thank you very much!

Changes v1.1:
- [b]"Enter the value" parameter.[/b] It seems that this parameter was bugged but I couldn't reproduce the issue so instead of making you restart every time you have this parameter until I find the bug (or the end of days), I preferred to deactivate it at the moment. Sorry about that.
- [b]Story texts.[/b] Some "lore" texts (top left corner during the photo edition) have been inverted during integration because we swapped some images, they now are all good.
- [b]Default volume for music.[/b] Some players complain that the default music volume was too high, we reduced it. If you already change the volume, it will not affect your parameters.
- [b]Achievement description.[/b] We edited some achievement descriptions in Game to better feet the descriptions in Steam.
- [b]Choose your folder option.[/b] Some players requested that we integrate a "choose your folder a option" exactly like we did in [b]OnlyFuck: RuRu's Adventures[/b] so anybody can custom his pictures destination when you save one from the gallery. It also allow to fix a bug where the save function doesn't work properly on certain configuration. 
This feature is in the roadmap for our next game which will use the same layout as Photo-Life so when it will be ready [u]we will integrate the change in Photo-Life but also in Hentai Day.[/u]

notes.title: Patch Note 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Here is Ben from NSFW18 Games! 
Here is a small update to fix the most important issues found by the players and reported on Discord, Twitter or in the reviews!

[h2]Improvement[/h2]
I also took the time to add [b]Tooltips on each parameter[/b] of the photo-editing to better explain them including the "enter the right value" one. 
They now are more understandable including some infos about the difference between easy/normal/hard difficulties.

[h2]List of fix:[/h2]
[olist]
[*][b] Plain color in Puzzle[/b]: it was possible to make the transition panel bug with a combination of elements including the right click making the full screen to be one color. Fixed.
[*][b] Dialogue bugs in Extra sections[/b]: The "Rina's Friends" and "Donator Special" sets had no dialogues and display a blank dialogue that was impossible to pass. Fixed.
[*][b] Player Name/Sample Name bug[/b]: some typos error were making the name of the player to not be displayed properly. Fixed.
[*][b] Gallery download pictures[/b]: The name of the game including a ":" (Photo-Life:Rina....) and the photo saver using the name of the game to save the pictures, it was causing a bug. It's now fixed, pictures are correctly saved as "PhotoLife-Rina.png" in your Pictures folder.
[*][b] Dialogue month error[/b]: The months displayed at the end of each dialogue were always one month ahead of reality "March is starting (for February)". Fixed.
[/olist]
